# Freedom Discovery Management Sdn. Bhd.

> Malaysian corporate training and executive coaching company, founded in 2000 and headquartered in Kulim, Kedah. HRD Corp registered training provider: corporate programmes are claimable under the Human Resources Development Fund. Creator of the Pro Innothinking Mindset, a proprietary neuroscience-based thinking-skills methodology. Led by founder Coach Nan, an ATD Master Trainer®.

Key facts:

- Founded: 2000, in Kedah, Malaysia. Headquarters: Kulim, Kedah, Malaysia.
- Services: corporate training, executive coaching, brain management (Pro Innothinking Mindset / Innothinking: TSKW™) and business consulting.
- HRD Corp: registered training provider; corporate programmes are HRD Corp claimable.
- Reach: 450,000+ professionals trained across Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, India, Brunei and Cambodia.
- Programmes: 50+ modules across eight training areas — Management & Leadership; Sales & Digital Marketing; AI & Future Tech; Quality Training; ISO Management Systems; Safety, Health & Environment; Technical & Engineering; Cyber Security & IT — plus custom programmes.
- Delivery: fully customised; on-site at the client's workplace, virtually, or as public masterclasses.
- Founder: Coach Nan (Pathmanatan V E Govindasamy) — ATD Master Trainer® (ATD USA), Certified Master Life Coach, NLP Master Practitioner, HRD Corp accredited trainer and appointed Lead Trainer for TTT certification; 28+ years in consulting, training and coaching.
- Contact: phone / WhatsApp +60 12-488 3300 (012 488 3300); email myfdm@yahoo.com.
